name: Pomegranate Tree The
overview: The pomegranate tree in Scripture symbolizes God's blessing and fruitfulness, as seen in the abundance of pomegranates in the land of Canaan and Egypt, described as fruitful orchards (Deuteronomy 8:8; Numbers 20:5). Its significance is further emphasized by its presence on the high priest's robe, where pomegranates were crafted alongside golden bells to signify holiness and divine service (Exodus 39:24-26). The fruit also represents the graces of the church and the spiritual nourishment of saints, reflecting God's favor in making His people fruitful and providing shade and sustenance.
